title: The truth is, you can't control your parents, siblings, or relatives....
author: @melrobbins

subtitles.en: There's an old saying
subtitles.cn: 有句老话说

subtitles.en: that fish and family both start to stink after three days.
subtitles.cn: 鱼和客人一样，三天后都会发臭。

subtitles.en: You ever notice that? I sure do.
subtitles.cn: 你注意到这个了吗？我确实注意到了。

subtitles.en: You all pile into a cabin for a week.
subtitles.cn: 你们一起挤进一个小木屋，待上一个星期。

subtitles.en: Somebody's always in the bathroom when you need it.
subtitles.cn: 你需要用卫生间的时候，总有人在里面。

subtitles.en: Your mom starts commenting on how much coffee you drink.
subtitles.cn: 你妈妈开始评论你喝多少咖啡。

subtitles.en: Your father is asking why you're always on your phone.
subtitles.cn: 你爸爸问你为什么总是玩手机。

subtitles.en: Your brother leaves his things all over your house.
subtitles.cn: 你弟弟把东西扔得满屋子都是。

subtitles.en: Children are over stimulated by day four.
subtitles.cn: 到了第四天，孩子们就过度兴奋了。

subtitles.en: Everybody's fighting about a kitchen sponge.
subtitles.cn: 每个人都在为一块厨房海绵吵架。

subtitles.en: So leave. On day three,
subtitles.cn: 所以，在第三天就离开吧。

subtitles.en: your only choice is to change the conditions
subtitles.cn: 你唯一的选择就是改变条件

subtitles.en: and focus on what you can control.
subtitles.cn: 并专注于你能控制的事情。

subtitles.en: So you have to change how you show up.
subtitles.cn: 所以你必须改变你的表现方式。

subtitles.en: This is what it looks like to set boundaries
subtitles.cn: 这就是设定界限的样子

subtitles.en: and to create conditions for something different to happen.
subtitles.cn: 并为不同的事情发生创造条件。

subtitles.en: Their behavior does not control your behavior.
subtitles.cn: 他们的行为不能控制你的行为。

subtitles.en: You control your behavior.
